name: Pixel Repetition
description: Analyzes 像素 pattern repetition in frame
algorithm: Pixel Repetition — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method detects pixel-level repetition patterns in video for deepfake detection:

1. **空间Repetition检测**: The method searches for exact or near-exact pixel pattern repetitions within each frame. Copy-paste manipulation and some AI generators produce repeated pixel patterns (tiled textures from the generator's feature map).

2. **GeneratorArchitecture伪影检测**: GAN generators using transposed convolution upsampling can produce characteristic periodic pixel patterns ("checkerboard artifacts") at the generator's stride frequency. The method detects these periodic spatial repetitions in the frequency domain using spectral analysis.

3. **时间像素Repetition**: The method checks for repeated pixel patterns across frames — exact pixel-level repetition between non-adjacent frames indicates artificial frame generation or copying. Natural video never produces exact pixel-level repetition between distinct frames.

4. **PatchSimilarity分析**: Local patches are compared using normalized cross-correlation. Unusually high similarity between distant patches (beyond what natural texture would produce) indicates AI generation where the generator's limited diversity manifests as repeated micro-patterns.

5. **Repetition-Scale分析**: Repetition is analyzed at multiple spatial scales. Natural textures can show repetition at macro scales (wallpaper, fabric patterns) but not at micro scales. AI-generated content may show micro-scale repetition invisible to human inspection but detectable statistically.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through 像素 repetition analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
